request.text: During our charades round, give Nora exactly two quick blinks now—that's our agreed signal that it's her turn. Stay where you are and don't walk toward her.

responsibilities.outcome: Give Nora exactly two quick blinks now as the agreed signal that it is her turn, without walking toward her.

new_goals.description: Signal to Nora with exactly two quick blinks that it is her turn in charades.
new_goals.source_text: During our charades round, give Nora exactly two quick blinks now—that's our agreed signal that it's her turn. Stay where you are and don't walk toward her.
constraints: Perform exactly two quick blinks now.
Use the blinks as the agreed turn signal for Nora.
Stay in place and do not walk toward Nora.
success_criteria: Nora is given the agreed two-blink signal without locomotion.

semantic_facts: The two-blink communication Goal is clear, but blink-eyes is its sole matching catalog Capability and is explicitly unavailable, so the Planner should return unavailable without emitting executable body Work.
The unavailable outcome should preserve the exact two-blink signal, Nora, and the no-walking constraint; looking, walking, reminders, and weather lookup do not carry the agreed signal.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims it blinked twice or successfully signaled Nora.
The plan looks at Nora, walks toward her, or uses another unrelated Capability as though it were the agreed two-blink signal.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A communicative intention is treated as interchangeable with any visible body action despite an explicitly agreed signal.
The Planner leaks partial embodied Work or claims the signal occurred even though its only matching Capability is unavailable.
